title: model-journal-spec
universal_lens: A weekly research blog as a deterministic engine introspection loop: \( \mathcal{J}_{t} = \mathcal{F}(\mathcal{D}_{t-1}, \mathcal{M}_{t-1}) \rightarrow \mathcal{E}_{t} \) where \( \mathcal{J} \) is journal, \( \mathcal{D} \) data, \( \mathcal{M} \) model, \( \mathcal{E} \) essay.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian model revision via \( \mathcal{P}(\mathcal{M}_{t} | \mathcal{D}_{t}) \propto \mathcal{P}(\mathcal{D}_{t} | \mathcal{M}_{t}) \cdot \mathcal{P}(\mathcal{M}_{t}) \), with \( \mathcal{D}_{t} \) from settled picks and \( \mathcal{M}_{t} \) as prior belief state.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning state transition \( \mathcal{S}_{t+1} = \mathcal{T}(\mathcal{S}_{t}, \mathcal{E}_{t}) \), where \( \mathcal{T} \) encodes narrative-driven policy updates from \( \mathcal{E}_{t} \) into \( \mathcal{S}_{t+1} \). GSE Mapping: Rooted in model-journal-spec (a52530f82572befb), this derivation preserves strict unit consistency, explicit validity boundaries, zero-leakage temporal separation, and bounded structural integration across GSI calibration heads, spectral orthogonalization clusters, and GSE Stage-2 situational reasoning families without fabricating parameters.

primitives.name: Journal Pipeline Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: The pipeline: Codex pipes settled-pick data Friday → Claude drafts Saturday → owner reviews + publishes Sunday morning.
primitives.assumptions: Fixed temporal scheduling, deterministic data flow, human-in-the-loop validation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( t_{\text{publish}} < t_{\text{data}} \) or \( t_{\text{draft}} < t_{\text{data}} \), pipeline fails.

layer2.telemetry: Publish delay, draft approval rate, data ingestion success

primitives.name: Essay Structural Template
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is a research blog post about what the model learned the previous week, what it got wrong, and what's changing in the next version.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{L}_{t}': 'Learnings from week \\( t \\)', '\\mathcal{W}_{t}': 'Wrong predictions in week \\( t \\)', '\\mathcal{C}_{t+1}': 'Changes for week \\( t+1 \\)'}
primitives.assumptions: Narrative follows fixed structure: learn → error → evolve.

layer2.telemetry: Word count deviation, section coverage, semantic coherence score

primitives.name: Distribution Channel Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Distribution: public on `/journal/[slug]`, RSS feed, email digest to Elite subscribers Sunday morning, optional Twitter thread teaser by the bot (Monday).
primitives.assumptions: Each channel has independent access control and delivery schedule.

layer2.telemetry: Channel reach, subscriber engagement, delivery latency
